items.title: Trendy Streetwear
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Want to look the coolest? Now you can! Try on these stylish outfits, and show them off to all of your friends.

+ 12 teen skins
+ A variety of streetwear outfits.

items.title: Gray Aesthetic
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Prefer dressing in darker colors? Then these are the skins for you!

+ 12 teen skins
+ A variety of gray clothes

items.title: Festive Elves
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:
The holiday little helpers are hard at work, busy making and wrapping up the perfect gifts for everyone. But they need your help! Join the team and show off your festive spirit today!

- 10 Festive Elves Skins!
- Perfect for the winter season!
- By Rainbow Theory Studios

items.title: Advanced Village
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Bored of the same old villages? Get ready to visit an advanced village, stack up on loot, help villagers protect their homes, and enjoy the new look!

- Hidden chests with loot!
- Rewarding survival experience!
- Perfect for roleplay!
- By RareLoot

items.title: Fire Force
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description: The fire force is here and ready to play! They have crawled from the deepest darkest depths, and these fiery creatures are here for a good time. Become a member today, of the hottest squad around!

items.title: Ninja City
items.creator: MobBlocks
items.description:
Two clans of ninjas battle it out in an ancient city. 
Visit the great palace, battle in the dojo, or relax in the zen garden.
Adventure off into the world or move into one of the houses in the city. 
This epic survival spawn is great to play alone or with friends.

items.title: Enderman Dragon Knights 3
items.creator: Hourglass Studios
items.description:
The Enderman Dragon Knights are back again for Winter! With these enderman you will be sure to rule the dark nights and make all your opponents fear you! Continue ruling the dragon world with these enderman warrior skins and rule the skies on your dragon! 

-10 Winter enderman skins!
-1 free skin!
By: Hourglass Studios

items.title: Fightnite
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Meet battle royale champions, they came to this game to build and win! They are skilled gamers and pros. Will you help them?

+ Battle Royale
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: Sad Masks
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Masked teens, what are they hiding behind their masks and why they are sad? Which mask are you? Show your style with unique sad emoji.

+ Teen fashion
+ Trendy
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: Fashion Demons
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Demonic teens are back in town. They are here to play, party and make new friends. Gather up with friends and take these lovely skins with you on your journeys.

+ Teen fashion
+ Anime
+ Demon
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: Neon Party
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
It's time for a neon party with these awesome raver skins! These bright and colorful glowing skins are perfect for throwing huge party or attending one! With so many cool designs to choose from which will you pick?

- 13 skins

items.title: Cute Animals HD
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
These animals are so precious and look adorable. Which of these cute skins will you choose to roleplay as? Minecraft is full of amazing animals and now you can become one!

- 12 animal skins

items.title: Cute Pixel Texture Pack
items.creator: Sapphire Studios
items.description:
Have you wanted a cute, colorful, and vibrant world? Changing up how you view Minecraft? Use this texture pack to create new structures and projects with this cute and fun look with these textures that you can use with any world!

- Support for 1.17
- Actively kept up to date

items.title: Holidays!
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
It's Holiday time!

Choose an awesome holiday themed skin for your next Minecraft adventure!

items.title: Speedrunners
items.creator: ChewMingo
items.description:
Speedrunners are fast and don't stop for anything! Are you a speedrunner?!

+ Modern teen skins

items.title: Winter Anime Fashion
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
Winter is coming, and now it's time to get winter-themed anime skins! Pick your favorite skin from this pack now and show off the anime fashion to all players!

+ 12 skins including 2 that are FREE!
+ Perfect for roleplay

items.title: Underwater Base
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Experience life underwater accompanied by aquatic creatures! Immerse yourself with the deep away from all to conduct your secret activity or live in peace.

+Fully furnished base!
+Huge base to explore!
+Aquatic creatures all around you!

And much more!

items.title: One Block Tycoon
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
One Block Tycoon! Earn points, expand your island, and upgrade all the islands to maximize their true potential!

+Acquire points for upgrades!
+Upgrade your islands to increase their production!
+ 9 islands with 3 upgrades each! 27 in total.

And much more!

items.title: Fantastic Cliffside Base
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Enjoy your relaxing stay with the fantastic view! Have a powerful rest and get ready for your next adventure!

+Refreshing survival base!
+Huge base to explore!
+Fully-furnished base!
+Peaceful and refreshing atmosphere!

And much more!

items.title: Fruits in Boots
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Behold! The galaxy's worst rhyme turned into a questionably stylish skin-pack!

-8 literal fruits in boots.
-A FREE Carrot skin! We did not invite them to the party, but we ain't complaining.
-Freshly made by MCVinnyq

items.title: The Tree of Life
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
In the heart of the largest forest on Earth, something special grows that few get to see. It goes by many names, but we know it as the Tree of Life! Stop by the village, visit the palace, and reign sovereign! Or will you make your home among the vast branches of the Tree itself?

- Giant tree to explore
- Custom terrain
- Play alone or with your friends
- Achievement ready

items.title: Royal Mobs
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:
These mobs rule the land, wearing the finest outfits and lavishly living in style. Wear your royal crown today and become the king or queen of your dreams!

- 10 Royal Mob Skins!
- 1 Free Skin!
- By Rainbow Theory Studios and Rio Eyo Studios

items.title: Animal Pajamas
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:
Are you ready for a super awesome sleepover? This animal pajama party is just getting started! Grab your outfits and get ready for a night of fun and games!

- 11 Pajama Skins!
- By Rainbow Theory Studios and Rio Eyo Studios

items.title: OP Skyblock
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Take to the skies in this unique skyblock world! Put on some super OP armor, and use the extremely powerful netherite tools to help on your journey! Each island also has a hidden shulker box to find.

+ Stylish skin included!
+ Over 20 unique islands to explore.
+ Overpowered tools and armor!
